card.name: Section numbers in label cross-references
card.fires_on: The spot just before a section or table number, such as the space or opening parenthesis after a comma in a list of cross-references, or the word Table before its number. Seen mostly in highlights-style label cross-references like (5.6) or (2.1, 5).

modes.label: Cross-reference lists
modes.description: Blank space or comma slot just before the next section number in a parenthesized list.

modes.label: Opening bracket before section
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after 'see Dosage and Administration' or a warning statement, right before the number.

modes.label: Table before its number
modes.description: The word Table when pointing to a numbered table.
